fix: replace all of them with a single: @import "tailwindcss";

msg: the *-opacity-* utilities were removed in v4
fix: use the slash syntax instead: bg-black/50, text-white/70

msg: flex-shrink-* / flex-grow-* were renamed in v4
decoration-slice / decoration-clone were removed in v4
outline-none changed meaning: in v4 it is outline-style:none, so the focus ring disappears in forced-colors mode
fix: write outline-hidden to keep the v3 behaviour

msg: the -sm step moved up one size in v4, so this renders larger than it did in v3
fix: write the same token with -xs to keep the v3 rendering

msg: the bare utility is one step smaller in v4 than in v3
fix: write shadow-sm, rounded-sm or blur-sm to keep the v3 rendering

msg: bare ring is 1px in v4 (3px in v3) and its default colour is currentColor, not blue-500
fix: write ring-3 ring-blue-500 to keep the v3 rendering

msg: border utilities are used but no border colour is ever named, and v4's default border colour is currentColor, not gray-200

fix: write bg-linear-to-r (and bg-radial / bg-conic for the new kinds)

msg: the dot-path theme() lookup is deprecated in v4
fix: read the generated CSS variable instead: var(--color-red-500)

msg: stacked variants apply left-to-right in v4, right-to-left in v3, so this targets nothing
square brackets around a bare CSS variable are parsed as an arbitrary value in v4
a v3 dash prefix is not recognised in v4
fix: a prefix is a variant in v4: tw:flex

msg: space-* uses a different selector in v4 (:not(:last-child)) and breaks on wrapped or reordered children
fix: put gap-4 on the flex or grid parent

msg: v4 does not read tailwind.config.js on its own, so every token in it is missing at build time
fix: point at it from the CSS entry: @config "./tailwind.config.js";

msg: custom utilities written inside @layer utilities are not registered by v4, so every variant of them silently stops working
@apply inside a component <style> block cannot see your theme in v4
fix: add @reference "../app.css"; at the top of the style block
